{{Quote|A convoy of Imperial Corvettes is headed for the Geedon system.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>}}
The '''Geedon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geedon V]].
